Unanimous Shareholder Agreement dated July 1, 2016, First Amending Agreement dated November 18, 2024 (approved by directors November 18, 2024). Two directors: one nominated by each shareholder while Luis Ortega holds at least 10% of Class A shares. Major decisions (sale of substantially all assets, issuance of shares, borrowing above $1,000,000, related-party transactions, change in business) require unanimous board approval. Right of first refusal (ROFR): shareholder wishing to sell Class A shares to third party must first offer to other shareholder at same price and terms; 30 days to accept all offered shares. 2024 amendment: ROFR does NOT apply to bona fide sale of 100% of issued shares (or substantially all assets) to arm's-length purchaser approved by board, completed on or before November 18, 2026, provided (a) Luis Ortega receives same price per Class A share and same form of consideration as Gord McAllister (tag-along); and (b) Luis Ortega may at his option exchange up to 100% of his Class A shares for equity in purchaser or acquisition vehicle instead of cash (if purchaser agrees). Drag-along: if holders of 80% or more of Class A shares accept arm's-length offer for 100% of shares, all other shareholders must sell on same per-share terms. Shotgun clause (section 9 of 2016 agreement) was deleted by 2024 amendment. Class D dividends at discretion of directors and do not require proportional dividend on Class A shares; Luis Ortega acknowledged and consented to Class D structure in 2016 in consideration of his annual bonus arrangement. Restrictive covenants: each shareholder agrees not to compete within Alberta or solicit customers or employees of corporation for two years after ceasing to be a shareholder.
